summary: Memory allocation entry point identified as nh_malloc. Takes a requested size a1 and a retry-flag a2. Rejects requests larger than 0xFFFFFFE0 by returning 0 immediately. Otherwise attempts the low-level allocation sub_58A973(a1); on failure it retries only when the retry flag is set, first invoking GlobalCallbackDispatcherWithNullCheck(a1) as a cleanup callback to free memory before the next attempt. Returns the allocated pointer, or 0 when allocation ultimately fails or the cleanup callback reports failure.

operations.description: Size guard: when the requested size a1 exceeds 0xFFFFFFE0, return 0 immediately without attempting an allocation.
Retry loop: keep attempting allocation while it fails and retries are permitted (retry flag a2 non-zero).
Perform the low-level allocation attempt: result = sub_58A973(a1).
On a failed allocation with retries enabled, invoke GlobalCallbackDispatcherWithNullCheck(a1) as a cleanup callback to free memory so the next allocation attempt can succeed.
Abort guard: when the cleanup callback returns 0 the allocation is abandoned and the function returns 0.
Return the allocated pointer from the successful low-level allocation, or 0 when the allocation fails and cannot be retried.
Used as the core allocation entry by OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper and MallocWrapperForNhMalloc.
